25a6e2ffdbf0.reason: history_for feeds a streaming answer that has already started, so there is no caller to hand the error to; the answer still goes out, and the failure is now in the log.

5c415d8b32fd.reason: Rounding down is intended: near a full window the aim is to free room, so with an odd count one more message goes into the summary rather than one fewer. Nothing is dropped; summarised messages stay in the summary, and keep never goes below two messages.
5c415d8b32fd.title: Off-by-one in message limit
